entries.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
entries.snippet: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

entries.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
entries.snippet: CNN, Politico and MS NOW were allowed back into the White House after some of their staff were earlier turned away.

entries.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
entries.snippet: The highpoint of his time in Paris will be a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people.

entries.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
entries.snippet: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.

entries.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
entries.snippet: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

entries.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
entries.snippet: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

entries.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

entries.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout
entries.snippet: Proceeds from the tour, which begins in Dublin next month, will go to organisations supporting Palestinians, he says.

entries.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
entries.snippet: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

entries.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
entries.snippet: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.

entries.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
entries.snippet: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

entries.title: Greek PM urges UK PM to return Elgin Marbles permanently
entries.snippet: Andy Burnham said in 2023 the sculptures should be returned to Greece with "no strings attached".

entries.title: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
entries.snippet: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June.

entries.title: Teen rocker Nene Royal becomes first Thai to win America's Got Talent
entries.snippet: Her heavy metal performance trumped nine other finalists, including magicians and even a robot crew.

entries.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn Gaza recovery plan
entries.snippet: The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

entries.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
entries.snippet: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

entries.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
entries.snippet: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

entries.title: Why India's Election Commission is in the eye of a storm - again
entries.snippet: India's polling monitor is facing yet another crisis of credibility with fresh allegations against its chief.

entries.title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
entries.snippet: Elisabeth Belien tells Kenneth Law's sentencing hearing she took the poison when she was just 23 years old.

entries.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
entries.snippet: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

entries.title: Long agenda, short meeting: Trump and Xi meet
entries.snippet: All Things Considered host Mary Louise Kelly talks with White House correspondent Emily Feng about the Trump/Xi summit.

entries.title: In one of their last votes before November, Senate GOP blocks effort to end Iran war
entries.snippet: The vote on a war powers resolution introduced by Democrats came at a moment when some Republicans have begun to distance themselves from President Trump over the ongoing conflict.

entries.title: RFK Jr.'s ethics filing reveals book deals worth millions of dollars
entries.snippet: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s annual financial disclosure reveals he has received two lucrative book advances and free flights from a friend while in office.

entries.title: Mortgage rates have just surpassed 7% for the first time in well over a year
entries.snippet: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

entries.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
entries.snippet: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

entries.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit amid underlying tensions
entries.snippet: Despite the pageantry and the cordial tone, expectations for any big breakthroughs on issues ranging from AI to Iran to a trade war truce are low.

entries.title: Judge restores journalists' White House access. And, Tucker Carlson on his MAGA split
entries.snippet: A judge has ordered that the Trump administration restore journalists' access to White House. And, Tucker Carlson sits down with Morning Edition 's Steve Inskeep for a Newsmakers interview.

entries.title: Needy couples got cash and a spending plan. Results were good -- and bad
entries.snippet: In Liberia, joint financial planning boosted cash aid's benefits. It also had an unexpected consequence for some families.

entries.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump
entries.snippet: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.

entries.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
entries.snippet: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

entries.title: Trump administration appeals to Supreme Court as 3rd-country deportations are thrown into question
entries.snippet: A ruling to halt deportations of people to countries other than their own threw a core immigration policy of the Trump administration into question, at least temporarily, and prompted a desperate appeal to the Supreme Court on Thursday.

entries.title: Congo faces health worker shortage as Ebola remains out of control, WHO says
entries.snippet: Congo is running short of health workers to staff treatment centers for history's fastest-growing Ebola outbreak, particularly in the eastern province of North Kivu where cases have surged 73% over three weeks, the World Health Organization said Wednesday.

entries.title: Son of Israel's ambassador to U.S. critically injured in attack in occupied West Bank
entries.snippet: The son of Israel's ambassador to the United States was gravely injured in a ramming attack in the occupied West Bank on Wednesday.

entries.title: African leaders press United Nations for permanent seats on Security Council
entries.snippet: As in years past, African leaders attending the U.N. General Assembly this year are demanding a reform of the powerful Security Council that would include permanent seats for countries from the continent in the global body's highest decision-making structure.

entries.title: AI, trade, Iran and Taiwan top agenda at Trump-Xi summit
entries.snippet: President Trump hosted Xi Jinping at the White House on the Chinese leader's first trip to Washington in more than 10 years. The pair held two meetings, and while the status of the press pool was still in doubt, they delivered remarks. Trump and the First Lady will host a State D

entries.snippet: To discuss Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington, Amna Nawaz spoke with Nicholas Burns and Samm Sacks. Burns is a former U.S. ambassador to China and is now at Harvard University. Sacks is a senior fellow at the Institute for America, China and the Future of Global A

entries.title: News Wrap: Netanyahu calls allegations of genocide in Gaza 'the biggest lie'

entries.title: How the diesel price spike is rippling through nearly every part of the economy
entries.snippet: A rapid surge in the price of diesel fuel is straining businesses and threatening to raise costs across the economy. It's also putting pressure on President Trump to bring relief at the pump, including through a diesel export ban that's been pushed by some Republican lawmakers ah

entries.title: 'We want more guardrails,' Kalshi CEO says as calls grow for prediction market regulation
entries.snippet: As prediction markets continue to expand, they are drawing attention in Washington and states across the country. Companies like Kalshi and Polymarket allow people to trade contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events, including elections. Liz Landers discussed the growing

entries.title: In a warming climate, should air conditioning be a right?
entries.snippet: Fall temperatures are finally cooling off much of the United States, but this past summer was yet another reminder that the climate is changing. Stephanie Sy reports on how some cities are considering whether residents should have a right to air conditioning. It's part of our ser

entries.title: Lock of hair settles questions about Thomas Jefferson and Sally Hemings
entries.snippet: Researchers say they have the most conclusive proof of Thomas Jefferson's paternity of Sally Hemings' children. A strand of hair found in Jefferson's Bible launched an investigation involving DNA scientists, historians, genealogists and descendants of both Jefferson and Hemings.

entries.title: China's Xi says 2 giant pandas will arrive at Atlanta's zoo in the coming days
entries.snippet: Chinese President Xi Jinping said Thursday that two giant pandas from China will arrive at Zoo Atlanta in the coming days, bolstering a loan program that at one time had lapsed as part of tensions between Beijing and Washington.

entries.title: 8 sailors attempted suicide on Lincoln carrier group's long deployment, Navy leader says
entries.snippet: Eight sailors attempted suicide while deployed with the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier strike group, which spent a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war, the Navy's top civilian leader said this week.

entries.title: ICE has wasted tens of millions of dollars with 'uninformed' detention plans, GAO finds
entries.snippet: Among the misspending was nearly $3 million to erect tents at Guantanamo Bay that were never used, $20 million to maintain purchased warehouses that are now being sold without having housed a single detainee, and excessive rates paid to hold detainees at a deficient and now-shutt

entries.title: Russian strikes kill 8 civilians in Ukraine as UN debates how to end the war
entries.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy appealed in a speech at the United Nations late Wednesday for countries to starve Russia of revenue through sanctions and trade bans, denying Moscow the money it needs to prolong the war.

entries.title: WATCH: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu addresses 2026 UN General Assembly
entries.snippet: Netanyahu said attacking Iran "was one of the easiest decisions I've ever had to make" and denounced as "moral cowards" a mass of delegates who walked out of the U.N. General Assembly when he took the podium to speak.

entries.title: WATCH: Palestinian President Abbas addresses 2026 UN General Assembly
entries.snippet: Abbas made the prerecorded remarks from his office in Ramallah after the United States denied him and other top Palestinian officials visas to attend the gathering for the second year in a row.

entries.title: WATCH: Senate rejects war powers resolution to halt military action in Iran as gas prices upend midterms
entries.snippet: The Senate tally, 49-50, coming days after Trump's bombastic address to the United Nations in which he threatened to "annihilate" Iran, was likely the last chance for lawmakers to go on record about the war ahead of November.

entries.title: New York sues prediction market Polymarket, calling it an unlicensed gambling operation that puts residents at risk
entries.snippet: Prediction market platforms have argued states do not have the authority to govern them because they are already regulated at the federal level by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

entries.title: Energy Department will spend nearly $2 billion to squeeze more electricity from the nation's aging power grid
entries.snippet: The money will go toward 31 projects across 26 states that are expected to produce more than 23 gigawatts of additional electricity capacity — enough to power 16 million homes.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: UNGA: Gaza dominates agenda as Abbas, Netanyahu speak
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza the "greatest lie of the century." Many delegates walked out for his General Assembly speech. Mahmoud Abbas also spoke earlier. DW has more.

entries.title: Three-way battle for power in world chess: Who will be elected FIDE president in Samarkand?
entries.snippet: The era of Russian presidents is coming to an end at the World Chess Federation (FIDE). Two Germans and one Kazakh are up for election. Among the issues at play are money, Kremlin influence, and unanswered questions.

entries.title: Ethiopia's military says it killed hundreds of TPLF rebels
entries.snippet: The TPLF fought against against the Ethiopian military from 2020 to 2022 in a conflict that saw hundreds of thousands of civilians killed. A resumption of fighting has sparked fears of another brutal war.

entries.title: After several difficult years, economists now expect German economy to grow
entries.snippet: Germany's economy is growing again, but recovery remains on shaky ground. High government spending is keeping the economy afloat, while energy prices, a shortage of skilled workers and debt continue to weigh on it.

entries.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico regain access to White House
entries.snippet: A federal judge has ordered President Trump to restore White House access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico after he banned the media outlets from the premises. Hours later, the media announced they had been granted access.

entries.title: Houthi advances in Yemen drive displacement, deepen humanitarian crisis
entries.snippet: With more than 132,000 people already displaced by the latest fighting and Houthi territorial gains, Yemen is on the brink of slipping back into a full-fledged humanitarian emergency. DW spoke with people on the ground.

entries.title: Nigeria, US agree to boost mining investment on sidelines of UN General Assembly
entries.snippet: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Nigeria and the US inked a new mining deal. Nigeria is home to deposits of lithium, gold, tin, gemstones, iron ore and phosphate.

entries.title: Extremist parties are thriving ― and that scares people
entries.snippet: Far-right and far-left parties are celebrating success after success, leaving moderate politicians in the dust and worrying many Germans. Political psychology helps us understand what's behind growing polarization.

entries.title: How renewed fighting in Tigray could spread across the Horn of Africa
entries.snippet: The fresh hostilities in Ethiopia's Tigray region come after months of growing animosity between rebel forces and the federal government. Horn of Africa expert Martin Plaut warns of possible regional spillover.

entries.title: Trump hosts Xi for state dinner with tech bosses
entries.snippet: Donald Trump has rolled out the red carpet for Chinese leader Xi Jinping, with the two set for a lavish state dinner after their summit meeting. America's tech bosses and prominent Chinese executives are also present.

entries.title: EU to condemn war in Ukraine at G20 even if Putin attends
entries.snippet: Russian President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the G20 summit in Miami by the United States. Multiple members of the group have called for Moscow's exclusion over its invasion of Ukraine.

entries.title: AI systems shifted their answers toward both left- and right-leaning users in a study. Could sycophantic chatbots deepen political divides?
entries.snippet: A study shows chatbots mirror users' politics, part of a broader tendency known as AI sycophancy. Researchers fear this could deepen polarization.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin officially withdraws Olympics bid
entries.snippet: Berlin's decision to withdraw its Olympic bid means that only Munich and the western Rhine/Ruhr region are left in the running as potential Olympic hosts. DW has more.

entries.title: Czech PM Andrej Babis reiterates importance of NATO for his country but rejects calls to increase defense spending
entries.snippet: The US and NATO want Czechia to spend more on defense. Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis says Prague cannot afford faster increases, despite growing warnings about the threat from Russia.

entries.title: 'Pope fever' takes hold as Pope Leo visits France
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV is expected to draw huge crowds during his visit to France. As part of his trip, he's also set to address Europe's future and some of the challenges ahead.

entries.title: EU finally clinching trade deals with Southeast Asian states
entries.snippet: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.

entries.title: Tensions between India and Bangladesh are in focus after Dhaka skipped the BRICS summit in Delhi
entries.snippet: Bangladesh's absence from the BRICS summit in New Delhi has raised fresh questions about strained ties. Ousted PM Sheikh Hasina's exile in India remains a major obstacle to normalizing relations.

entries.title: India news: Cockroach party demands Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
entries.snippet: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke has alleged that the removal of more than 130 million names from draft electoral rolls is designed to benefit the BJP and weaken opposition parties. DW has more.

entries.title: Poland says Starlink station fire 'act of sabotage'
entries.snippet: Polish Deputy Prime Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said Warsaw believed the attack aimed to disrupt internet access for the Ukrainian military, calling it "an element of the next phase of hybrid warfare."
